quests.title: Fallen Star: find and protect the fallen child
quests.reason: Hanel explicitly asks the player to reach and help any survivor before the Church; the forest rescue, circuit report, underground investigation and reply advance sw_fs_main_step0 through step3, Hanel reacts to the returned child and circuit, and the return/siege sets sw_fs_main_done and triggers end_fs_act1. Door and puzzle components are steps, not additional quests.

quests.title: Toma's flatbread deliveries
quests.reason: Toma requests four deliveries to named people elsewhere; recipient switches and var_fs_q_bread_given record them, and returning with four delivered awards starlight bread, reveals his connection to Kael and unlocks its sale.

quests.title: Marta's missing silver spoons
quests.reason: Marta asks for six missing spoons; clues lead to two in the flour sack and four from Toby at the bridge, setting sw_fs_q_spoon_found; Marta removes six spoons and awards a free-night voucher. The separate inn service is not the quest.

quests.title: Rohan's spear
quests.reason: Rohan explicitly requests three wolf fangs and one wisp ember from the forest, then consumes materials and awards a spear or, with an additional stariron shard, a sword. The cited wolf/wisp battles match his stated sources; troop loot tables and a stariron pickup event are not shown in this dump.

quests.title: Borrowed Fire: recover Iris and reach the sky-tower lens
quests.reason: Included as the required registered main quest: Hanel gives his seal and explicitly sends the party to the tower where he promises the rest of the story; rescue and travel happen elsewhere, Iris rejoins, Hanel fulfills that promise at the summit, and the collector aftermath records the Act 2 endpoint. This is the visible release-ending flag, not an invented fs2_main_done; troop/common-event internals are absent.

quests.title: Oden's antidote
quests.reason: Oden requests two forest-spider venom sacs; returning consumes two item_fs_venom_sac, awards three potions and sets the completion switch. Spider encounter events are visible, but their troop loot definitions are outside this dump.

quests.title: Toby's lost red kite
quests.reason: Toby's written request on the board starts the quest; a separate forest event yields the kite and found flag, and Toby removes it and gives 100G plus a star-scent pouch. The board is the actual request event, not Toby's unrelated initial spoken dialogue.

quests.title: Mire's three unlit lamps
quests.reason: Mire explicitly asks for lamps to be hung on three other households' doors and asks the player to return; three separate lamp flags unlock her acknowledgement and two starlight breads.

quests.title: The first child's fish
quests.reason: Harma asks for one trout at the eastern ice holes; any of three fishing events supplies the trout and caught flag, and returning consumes it and awards Harma's silver oar.

quests.title: Recover the confiscated belongings
quests.reason: Borderline included: Elena at the ladder tells the player to retrieve their belongings from the adjacent chest before leaving; a different chest event records the bundle and sw_fs2_barracks_cleared, and returning to the ladder explicitly acknowledges the recovered medicine pouch and awards supplies once. This has a request, external action and rewarded return, beyond a bare exit lock.

quests.title: Tell Sarah to hold her head high
quests.reason: Borderline included as a message-delivery task: Rohan explicitly asks Kael to tell his daughter 'hold your head high'; at the distant fortress Kael delivers the exact message and Sarah recognizes its origin before her battle/recruitment. sw_fs2_sarah_joined is the enclosing encounter's persistent outcome, not a dedicated message-delivered flag; its consumers are visible, while the battle-side setter is outside this event dump.

quests.title: Read Iris's scattered memories back to her
quests.reason: Borderline included: Iris explicitly asks Kael to read again and identifies her fallen journal pages; the player reads two separate floor-page events to the accompanying Iris, recording sw_fs2_page_star_read and sw_fs2_page_hand_read, restoring skills and finally granting 'Be well' with her acknowledgement. The companion receives the task at the page locations, so no return walk is necessary.

notQuests.reason: Four-brazier order puzzle gives treasure and sets sw_puzzle_fs_braziers_solved for the bars, but its instructions come from a tablet, not a character's commission; it is not a separate quest from fs_main.
These copies only test the star key obtained during the rescue, set sw_fs_vault_open and transfer downstairs; the lock is not a new quest.
Iris's presence activates the lens, which sets sw_fs_vault_seal_open for the four stair tiles; this is a main-quest access mechanism, with no separate requester and turn-in.
West/sun/moon switches open routes in sequence and a wrong order triggers an alarm fight; the written orders address Church soldiers, not a player commission.
Borderline rejected: the prisoner asks to be freed, but both answers immediately reveal a trap and fight at the same event; no task at another event and no rescue turn-in exist.
The west lever enables a patrol ambush with sw_fs_b3_patrol_done, but nobody asks the player to defeat this patrol or receives a report.
The moon-lever flag enables an enemy ambush; sw_fs_b3_ledge_done records winning an unsolicited encounter, not a commissioned hunt.
Borderline rejected: the wounded fanatic gives dragon tactics and reacts to sw_fs_dragon_down, but never asks for the kill; Elena's offer of water has no implemented water fetch/turn-in.
Taking Lisa's belongings can set sw_fs_lisa_banned and block her door; this is theft punishment, not a requested task with a turn-in.
The entrance checks sw_fs_osborn_banned and rejects a thief; the dump supplies no request or restorative task behind this access flag.
Iris joining and bread completion select a telescope vignette; writing the first journal line happens immediately in this one event and only sets sw_fs_scope_journal_played, with no external task.
Mire changes her lines after sw_fs_iris_joined and suggests visiting Toma; she assigns no task whose completion she receives.
Valen's departure enables lantern lore; the grandmother does not request an investigation or reward a later report.
Both react to sw_fs_iris_joined with songs/rumors and secrecy, not an assigned external objective.
The spear-quest condition enables Rohan's response to reading Sarah's letter; permission to read a drawer is optional backstory, not a second delivery or repair quest.
sw_fs_knight_marched changes the visibility-dependent theft punishment for looting potions; no one commissioned the looting.
sw_fs_valen_marched unlocks the confiscation-list chest and a potion, possibly with a fine; finding lore and loot without a requester is not a quest.
Rino's cryptic bread hint leads to a hidden key and sw_fs2_cell_open; it is an escape/key puzzle, not an explicit fetch request and turn-in.
sw_fs2_barracks_mid changes where capture returns the player; sneaking past patrols and a checkpoint are mechanics, not another quest beyond the separately labeled belongings request.

Mire's initial well directions set sw_fs2_mire_well to expose a route to Hanel; this navigation hint has no separate turn-in. Her later three-lamp commission is a real quest and is labeled separately.
sw_fs2_hanel_told merely unlocks the smithy entrance; a door reacting to the main-story conversation is not a quest.
Rohan's flag exposes Bram, the hole starts pursuit, and crossing into his forest ends it; Bram helps the party escape rather than commissioning work for a later turn-in.

Borderline rejected: three clues unlock Serin's form and Valen later reacts to it, but no character asks the player to investigate Dawnwell or recover that document; Kael initiates exploration himself.
Pulling the lever opens remote bars via sw_fs2_fortress_f2_lever; there is no requesting character or turn-in.
These north-gate tiles only react to Sarah joining and permit passage; they are not an additional quest.
The arrival scene grants Ember Melt and using it clears shared ice tiles through sw_ev_fs2_snow_ice_open; this teaches a traversal skill without a commission or turn-in.
Harma's advice to wait at the inn sets up a sw_fs2_harma_told-gated transition to night, not a commissioned task; her distinct trout request is a quest.

Borderline rejected despite the text calling it 'Requisitioned Firewood' completed: villagers describe shortages but never ask the player to retrieve the sled; Sarah orders the soldier directly in one conversation, setting sw_fs2_q6_sled_back and free lodging without a player-accepted external task.
Sword/lantern choices and the optional Serin-form reaction culminate in sw_fs2_valen_lake_met and opened tower access; Valen never commissions a separate task here.
Borderline rejected: companions shout to run during an immediate hazard; timer completion and sw_fs2_ice_crossed acknowledge surviving, not turning in a commissioned errand.

Borderline rejected: the party falls into a split-wing trap and coordinates two mechanisms to reunite; Elena reports being blocked rather than assigning an errand, and fs2t2_done marks puzzle recovery rather than a quest turn-in.
Rotating mirrors calls the beam common event and opens a stair barrier with sw_fs2_t3_mirror_solved; nobody asks the player to solve it as a separate task.
Iris's recovered skill/presence and sw_fs2_iris_back remove darkness and stair restrictions; these are rescue-dependent traversal gates, not new quests.
sw_fs2_t1_arrive enables a knight who immediately gives supplies and advises avoiding the machine; the items reward no prior requested task.

The confession and sw_fs2_top_hanel_come/release-stop dialogue are the payoff of fs2_main, not an additional quest to make Hanel confess; character dialogue changes alone do not establish another commission.

Borderline rejected as an incomplete delivery arc: Toby explicitly gives a spoon for the star and sets sw_fs2_toby_spoon, but the complete dump contains no later spoon delivery, consumption, acknowledgement or turn-in.
Borderline rejected: 'bring forest materials' advertises a repeatable paid crafting service; recipe success in var_fs_craft_ok is a transaction result, not completion of an assigned quest.
